title: Mark Felt pushes to investigate the Mexico bank account

tellings.quote: Mark felt was getting he's the guy that was insisting upon going down the next morning to Mexico to investigate the bank account

plain: In 1972 Mark Felt, a senior FBI official, insisted on going to Mexico the very next morning to look into a bank account, according to the lawyer Dan Sheehan. Sheehan tells Michels this from memory, without naming a source, and he mentions Felt's boss at the bureau, Pat Gray, alongside him. The account matters to Sheehan because he links it to money in the Watergate affair, so Felt's push would have meant following that money to its source.
